name: Redington Ltd
title: Redington Ltd - 532805 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Record Q4 revenue up 25% to INR33,269 cr and PAT ex-exceptional at 1.4% margin, but Middle East war hits Q1 and FY27 guidance is only soft, with management conserving cash for large deals and M&A.

triggers.label: ASP-led PC growth sustaining
triggers.quote: A significant part of the increase would be on account of ASP and the marginal increase will be on account of units.

triggers.label: AR provisions elevated, working capital may rise
triggers.quote: working capital could stay where it is or maybe it could go up because we may have to give more credit

triggers.label: Q1 seasonally soft; Middle East hit for 1-2 quarters
triggers.quote: We will see a little bit of softness for the first quarter.

triggers.label: Gross margin pressure lost from COVID-type boom
triggers.quote: as we speak now, we don't think that could be visible in the current scheme of things.

guidance.quote: we would like to maintain between 5.5% and 6% is our intent and plan
outside of Arena about 2.2%, 2.3%, 2.4% is what we expect as EBITDA
we are quite confident in terms of the return on capital employed being maintained above 18%

guidance.value: loss next year at reduced level; profit in subsequent year
guidance.quote: next year, we will see loss but maybe at a reduced level
For the full year, it's about INR 2,500 crores, close to INR 2,500 crores.

red_flags.label: Receivable provisions and Saudi government receivables
red_flags.quote: AR for the current quarter is on the higher side

red_flags.label: Arena impairment and Turkey exit
red_flags.quote: The impact on the group PAT after minority interest is INR75.2 crores.

red_flags.label: Insurance withdrawn on war risk
red_flags.quote: the insurance companies joined together with 7 day’s notice removed this risk coverage

evasions.topic: Margin split large deals vs core
evasions.quote: I don't think in any way we can compare margins in the large deals vis -a-vis the core business.
So I don't want to commit anything here.
